description.content: Retrieves all metadata for a given file.

variable.description:
(Required) The unique identifier that represents a file.

The ID for any file can be determined
by visiting a file in the web application
and copying the ID from the URL. For example,
for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123`
the `file_id` is `123`.

response.name:

In most cases only values that are present in the metadata template
will be accepted, except for the `global.properties` template which accepts
any key-value pair.

item.name: Box Update metadata instance on file

request.name: Box Update metadata instance on file

description.content:
Updates a piece of metadata on a file.

The metadata instance can only be updated if the template has already been
applied to the file before. When editing metadata, only values that match
the metadata template schema will be accepted.

The update is applied atomically. If any errors occur during the
application of the operations, the metadata instance will not be changed.

the `file_id` is `123`.
(Required) The scope of the metadata template
(Required) The name of the metadata template

custom template data included.
